
---
title: "Albums"
---

```{r}
source("data_prep.R")

library(htmltools)

albums <- df %>%
  distinct(cdseq, `psux year`, `album name`) %>%
  arrange(cdseq)

# Build the clickable album covers
cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(albums)), function(i) {
  album <- albums[i, ]
  album_id <- paste0("album-", album$cdseq)

  tags$div(
    class = "album-card",
    tags$a(
      href = paste0("#", album_id),
      tags$img(
        src = paste0("covers/psx", album$cdseq, ".jpg"),
        alt = as.character(album$`album name`),
        loading = "lazy"
      )
    ),
    tags$div(class = "album-title",
             as.character(album$`album name`)),
    tags$div(class = "album-year",
             as.character(album$`psux year`))
  )
})

# Build a track listing for each album

# Build a track listing for each album

# Identify which songs have lyric files
lyrics_files <- list.files(
  "song_lyrics",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

lyrics_ids <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(lyrics_files))
))

# Build a track listing for each album
track_sections <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(albums)), function(i) {
  album <- albums[i, ]

  tracks <- df %>%
    filter(cdseq == album$cdseq) %>%
    arrange(sort) %>%
    mutate(track_number = row_number())

  tags$section(
    id = paste0("album-", album$cdseq),
    class = "album-tracks",
    tags$h2(as.character(album$`album name`)),
    tags$p(paste("Year:", album$`psux year`)),
    tags$ol(
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(tracks)), function(j) {
        song_id <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(tracks$sort[j]))
        song_title <- as.character(tracks$songname[j])

        title_element <- if (
          !is.na(song_id) && song_id %in% lyrics_ids
        ) {
          tags$a(
            href = paste0("lyrics.html#lyrics-", song_id),
            song_title
          )
        } else {
          tags$span(song_title)
        }

        tags$li(
          title_element,
          tags$span(
            class = "track-artist",
            paste(" — ", as.character(tracks$artist[j]))
          ),
          tags$span(
            class = "track-duration",
            paste0(" (", as.character(tracks$time[j]), ")")
          )
        )
      })
    ),
    tags$p(tags$a(href = "#top", "Back to album covers"))
  )
})



htmltools::browsable(
  tags$div(
    tags$div(id = "top"),
    tags$div(class = "album-grid", cards),
    tags$hr(),
    tags$h1("Track Listings"),
    track_sections
  )
)
```
